method:
Player-prop rankings v2 (2026-11-20) -> ../../v4_cache/prop_rankings.json (+ .md). Read-only; never trades.
Same position method as analyze.py (per condition: pnl = sells + redeems - buys; unredeemed held = loss, conservative;
two-sided conditions netted onto the larger side) plus, to match the main v4 method and the user's rules:
  * empirical-Bayes shrinkage with the CURRENT v4_cache/rankings.json prior (props' own method-of-moments tau2 collapses to 0)
  * lcb90 = flat ROI - 1.645*SE
  * flip detection: share of positions where >=30% of bought shares were sold before settlement ("flipper" if >=30%)
  * win rate vs average price paid (break-even) and the 40-60c slice
  * tiers per (wallet, league, prop_type) and fallback (wallet, league, ALL):
      keep  = n>=50, lcb90>0, score>+2%, two-sided<20%, flip<30%, staked>=$2k, avg entry<85c, active in last 30 days, wallet all-prop $ROI>=0
      watch = not keep; n>=50, score>+1%, flat ROI>0, $ROI>0, two-sided<20%, flip<30%, avg entry<85c, active in last 45 days, wallet all-prop $ROI>=0
      drop  = everything else
Env: ROWS_DIR (default rows_1120), CUT (settled = game date < CUT; default 2026-11-19 = 1-day redemption lag).
lookup: scanner uses (wallet, league, prop_type) when that row has n>=30, else (wallet, league, ALL); copy only status keep/watch
